blightsabre.title: blightsabre
blightsabre.name: [color=#a050a0]Blight Moplah[/color]
blightsabre.rumor: 一把被复仇之死附魔的弯刃。

snakeidol.title: snakeidol
snakeidol.name: [color=#70ff00]Serpent Idol[/color]
snakeidol.rumor: 一枚蛇类圣物的祖母绿圣像。

opalchakram.title: opalchakram
opalchakram.name: [color=#5080ff]Opal Chakram[/color]
opalchakram.rumor: 一枚北方人的圣物图符。

TransalChakram.title: TransalChakram
TransalChakram.name: [color=#5080ff]Transal Chakram[/color]
TransalChakram.rumor: 一枚由虚空游荡骑士挥舞过的轮刃

EmeraldChakram.title: EmeraldChakram
EmeraldChakram.name: [color=#00ff50]翡翠轮刃[/color]

Anwar.title: Anwar
Anwar.name: [color=#ffa070]Anwar[/color]
Anwar.rumor: 一枚金属圆环，灌注着从星界墙外捕获的致盲光芒

cursedskull.title: cursedskull
cursedskull.name: [color=#a0a000]Cursed Skull[/color]
cursedskull.rumor: 一枚死灵法师的圣物图符。

staffcrimson.title: staffcrimson
staffcrimson.name: [color=#ff1010]Crimson Staff[/color]
staffcrimson.rumor: 一根曾用于隧道之地鲜血节庆的法杖

ratbanner.title: ratbanner
ratbanner.name: [color=#c0c040]Rat Banner[/color]
ratbanner.rumor: 一面鼠兴者的旗帜。鼠人佣兵的徽记

spearpoison.title: spearpoison
spearpoison.name: [color=#70e030]维尼长矛[/color]
spearpoison.rumor: 一支饰有毒素符印的长矛。曾由北方污秽谷地的一名 venite 冠军携带

cudgelice.title: cudgelice
cudgelice.name: [color=#5080ff]安加棍棒[/color]
cudgelice.rumor: 一根饰有寒冰符印的棍棒。曾属于裂隙之地的一位 Granga 术士

scimitar.title: scimitar
scimitar.name: [color=#ffb040]Scimitar[/color]
scimitar.rumor: 一把精良弯刀，因东方沙漠的一名游方冠军而闻名

talwar.title: talwar
talwar.name: [color=#a0ffa0]塔瓦弯刀[/color]
talwar.rumor: 一把能净化持有者的仪式大刃。很久以前由神殿之地的一名 Naqui 铁匠锻造

seshaknife.title: seshaknife
seshaknife.name: [color=#8030af]舍沙弯匕[/color]
seshaknife.rumor: 一把 Shesha 枪阵兵奉为圣物的弯刀。在地下海的泥城邦中象征崇高声望

transalspear.title: transalspear
transalspear.name: [color=#8050af]Transal Spear[/color]
transalspear.rumor: 一支由虚空游荡骑士挥舞过的长矛

xyston.title: xyston
xyston.name: [color=#af8f50]Xyston[/color]
xyston.rumor: 一支从巨人之岛冲上海岸的重型战矛

swiftblade.title: swiftblade
swiftblade.name: [color=#50e0a0]Swift Blade[/color]
swiftblade.rumor: 一把模糊不清的剑。曾属于盐原的一位刺客女王

tachi.title: tachi
tachi.name: [color=#3070af]Tachi[/color]
tachi.rumor: 一把来自黎明沼泽的优雅斩剑

Claideb.title: Claideb
Claideb.name: [color=#30af30]Claideb[/color]
Claideb.rumor: 一把深林裸胸掠袭者奉为圣物的青铜剑

noxiousdagger.title: noxiousdagger
noxiousdagger.name: [color=#70e030]毒秽匕首[/color]
noxiousdagger.rumor: 一把 Brud 污秽仪式奉为圣物的金色匕首

AcidKnife.title: AcidKnife
AcidKnife.name: [color=#ffd000]酸蚀短刀[/color]
AcidKnife.rumor: 一把 Heliot 消融之舞奉为圣物的黄铜匕首

boneknife.title: boneknife
boneknife.name: [color=#ffa080]Bone Knife[/color]
boneknife.rumor: 一把由倒下夜蛇的毒牙制成的匕首

DreadAxe.title: DreadAxe
DreadAxe.name: [color=#a0a080]Dread Axe[/color]
DreadAxe.rumor: 一把献给被囚禁死亡洞神的巨斧

goldenaxe.title: goldenaxe
goldenaxe.name: [color=#30af30]Scia Axe[/color]
goldenaxe.rumor: 一把青铜巨斧，曾由深林中一位无敌战士王挥舞

agraaxe.title: agraaxe
agraaxe.name: [color=#ff2090]阿格拉巨斧[/color]
agraaxe.rumor: 一把从废弃 Volkite 神殿劫掠来的巨斧。寄宿着神圣的紫色火焰

redaxe.title: redaxe
redaxe.name: [color=#af4040]Red Axe[/color]
redaxe.rumor: 一把红色铁质巨斧。曾属于一位受诅咒的战争王子

BerserkerAxe.title: BerserkerAxe
BerserkerAxe.name: [color=#ff5020]Berserker Axe[/color]
BerserkerAxe.rumor: 一把来自深林的斧头，会激起不受约束的暴力

azarblade.title: azarblade
azarblade.name: [color=#ff7000]阿扎尔斧[/color]
azarblade.rumor: 一把由燃烧之地 excorite 铁匠锻造的斧头

bonesword.title: bonesword
bonesword.name: [color=#ffa080]Sange Axe[/color]
bonesword.rumor: 一把由倒下夜蛇的脊骨制成的斧头

boneshield.title: boneshield
boneshield.name: [color=#ffa080]Bone Shield[/color]
boneshield.rumor: 一面由倒下夜蛇的颅骨制成的盾牌

Acid_Shield.title: Acid_Shield
Acid_Shield.name: [color=#ffd000]酸符盾[/color]
Acid_Shield.rumor: 一面铁盾，上有被埋葬 Heliot 国王的黄色符印

skiagh.title: skiagh
skiagh.name: [color=#30af30]Skiagh[/color]
skiagh.rumor: 一面由深林裸胸冠军携带的盾牌

clipeus.title: clipeus
clipeus.name: [color=#ffa060]圆盾[/color]
clipeus.rumor: 一面彩绘圆盾，上有传奇 mubarizun 的符印

diskos.title: diskos
diskos.name: [color=#ffa060]刃盘[/color]
diskos.rumor: 一面来自失落 Shuppurak 竞技场的刃盾

rinoir.title: rinoir
rinoir.name: [color=#ffa050]Rinoir[/color]
rinoir.rumor: 一把由海岸平原决斗大师携带的短刀

bladeamethyst.title: bladeamethyst
bladeamethyst.name: [color=#9050df]紫晶镰剑[/color]
bladeamethyst.rumor: 一把被神殿之地某位 bheith nochti 遗弃的长刃

bladeemerald.title: bladeemerald
bladeemerald.name: [color=#30af00]Viper Dao[/color]
bladeemerald.rumor: 一把灌注毒素魔法的弯剑。由黎明沼泽的隐士铁匠锻造

bladeruby.title: bladeruby
bladeruby.name: [color=#ff4040]Ruby Kaskara[/color]
bladeruby.rumor: 一把黄铜剑柄的直剑。曾由燃烧之地的战争女王挥舞

GoldenSword.title: GoldenSword
GoldenSword.name: [color=#ffaf00]黄金长矛[/color]
GoldenSword.rumor: 一支由活金锻造的长矛。被深林的一位冠军从 Hobgoblin 宝库中盗走

lancestorm.title: lancestorm
lancestorm.name: [color=#0060ff]Storm Lance[/color]
lancestorm.rumor: 一支由风暴神殿高阶祭司附魔的长矛

bladeastral.title: bladeastral
bladeastral.name: [color=#9050df]Astra Blade[/color]
bladeastral.rumor: 一把缠绕微光紫色缎带的刀刃。据说从星界墙上坠落而来

macemind.title: macemind
macemind.name: [color=#ffaf30]Mind Mace[/color]

pinecleaver.title: pinecleaver
pinecleaver.name: [color=#20af20]Pine Cleaver[/color]

scutum.title: scutum
scutum.name: [color=#ff9060]高盾[/color]

scythevine.title: scythevine

scythescorch.title: scythescorch
scythescorch.name: [color=#ff8000]火焰镰[/color]

Feith_Shillelagh.title: Feith_Shillelagh
Feith_Shillelagh.name: [color=#60af20]Feith Shillelagh[/color]
Feith_Shillelagh.rumor: 一根由深林藤蔓僧侣制成的棍棒

Sioc_Shillelagh.title: Sioc_Shillelagh
Sioc_Shillelagh.name: [color=#5080ff]Sioc Shillelagh[/color]
Sioc_Shillelagh.rumor: 一根由高地冰川游牧民携带的棍棒

blightsabre2.title: blightsabre2
blightsabre2.name: [color=#a0a000]Blight Sabre[/color]
blightsabre2.rumor: 一把由死亡之门枯萎祭司附魔的弯刃

jadeshield.title: jadeshield
jadeshield.name: [color=#50f080]Zengja[/color]

mindsaber.title: mindsaber
mindsaber.name: [color=#ffaf30]Mindsaber[/color]
mindsaber.rumor: 一柄无刃剑柄，曾由黄色教会的一名闪光僧侣挥舞

wildclub.title: wildclub
wildclub.name: [color=#e0a050]Wild Club[/color]
wildclub.rumor: 一根由深林巨怪挥舞的巨大棍棒

warhammer.title: warhammer
warhammer.name: [color=#e0a050]Warhammer[/color]
warhammer.rumor: 一把由神殿之地巨人打造的重锤

zclaw.title: zclaw
zclaw.name: [color=#ff5020]Zasadzka Claw[/color]
zclaw.rumor: 一副手爪，因海岸平原的一名游方决斗者而闻名

kwhip.title: kwhip
kwhip.name: [color=#afaf70]Kaza Whip[/color]
kwhip.rumor: 一条由东方沙漠部落首领携带的圣鞭

inugreatsword.title: inugreatsword
inugreatsword.name: [color=#5080ff]伊努大剑[/color]
inugreatsword.rumor: 一把被寒冰附魔的大剑。由高地冰川的一名 Inuga 战士锻造

crystalrod.title: crystalrod
crystalrod.name: [color=#8030af]水晶杖[/color]

vond.title: vond

azarus.title: azarus
azarus.name: [color=#ff7000]Azarus[/color]
azarus.rumor: 一枚燃烧之地祭司奉为圣物的图符

CobraIdol.title: CobraIdol
CobraIdol.name: [color=#a0a000]眼镜蛇法杖[/color]

staff_earth.title: staff_earth
staff_earth.name: [color=#af8f50]Earth Staff[/color]
staff_earth.rumor: 一根由神殿之地土法师遗弃的魔法杖

BerserkerStaff.title: BerserkerStaff
BerserkerStaff.name: [color=#ff5020]Rage Fetish[/color]
BerserkerStaff.rumor: 一根饰有颅骨的木杖，与狂战之道神圣调谐。是深林祭司的圣物

jadepilum.title: jadepilum
jadepilum.name: [color=#50f080]Jade Pilum[/color]
jadepilum.rumor: 一支闪光长矛，曾由失落 Shuppurak 的哨兵挥舞

firestaff.title: firestaff
firestaff.name: [color=#ff7000]Fire Staff[/color]
firestaff.rumor: 一根由游荡于燃烧之地的火法师遗弃的魔法杖

deathstaff.title: deathstaff
deathstaff.name: [color=#a0a000]Death Staff[/color]
deathstaff.rumor: 一根由游荡于冰封荒原的死亡法师遗弃的魔法杖

StaffStar.title: StaffStar
StaffStar.name: [color=#8020a0]Star Staff[/color]
StaffStar.rumor: 一根来自山地神殿之地的魔法杖。被有志苦行者珍视

vilestaff.title: vilestaff
vilestaff.name: [color=#00ff50]Serpent Fetish[/color]

icestaff.title: icestaff
icestaff.name: [color=#5080ff]Ice Staff[/color]
icestaff.rumor: 一根在 Surtmir 征服期间从破碎冰神殿盗走的魔法杖

lightningstaff.title: lightningstaff
lightningstaff.name: [color=#0060ff]Lightning Staff[/color]
lightningstaff.rumor: 一根闪光魔法杖。曾属于风暴神殿的一位天才雷霆祭司

mindeye.title: mindeye
mindeye.name: [color=#ffaf30]Brazen Eye[/color]
mindeye.rumor: 一颗悬浮的金色眼睛。黄色教会的圣遗物

EmeraldEye.title: EmeraldEye
EmeraldEye.name: [color=#00ff50]Emerald Eye[/color]
EmeraldEye.rumor: 一颗拥有催眠力量的悬浮祖母绿眼睛。曾为黎明沼泽的一位蛇王所有

arjaspear.title: arjaspear
arjaspear.name: [color=#5080ff]Arja Spear[/color]

ToothedSword.title: ToothedSword
ToothedSword.name: [color=#ff1010]Toothed Sword[/color]

RebelJambiya.title: RebelJambiya
RebelJambiya.name: [color=#ffa020]Rebel Jambiya[/color]

StaffStasis.title: StaffStasis
StaffStasis.name: [color=#ff70b0]Staff of Excruciation[/color]
StaffStasis.rumor: 一根饰有内折符印的紫色痛苦法杖。曾由失落 Shuppurak 的“流浪之王”携带

ShieldMirage.title: ShieldMirage
ShieldMirage.name: [color=#ffaf30]Mirage Shield[/color]
ShieldMirage.rumor: 一面摇曳光芒之盾。刻有黄色教会扭曲的经文

ShieldMed.title: ShieldMed
ShieldMed.name: [color=#8030af]Sraval Shield[/color]
ShieldMed.rumor: 一面紫色盾牌，曾由守卫星界墙的大法师挥舞

StaffChaos.title: StaffChaos
StaffChaos.name: [color=#ff50ff]Staff of Chaos[/color]
StaffChaos.rumor: 一根因狂暴能量而震颤的法杖。曾被恶魔王们持有，作为权威证明

StaffLife.title: StaffLife
StaffLife.name: [color=#00a000]Staff of Life[/color]

WindRibbon.title: WindRibbon
WindRibbon.name: [color=#5070a0]Wind-laced Ribbon[/color]
WindRibbon.rumor: 一条曾由东方沙漠传奇 Amir 挥舞的缎带；据说她的游牧民能跑赢狂风

CosmicFlail.title: CosmicFlail
CosmicFlail.name: [color=#8030af]Cosmic Flail[/color]
CosmicFlail.rumor: 一把爆发光芒的连枷。蕴含着被吞噬之星的愤怒怨火

Pulwar.title: Pulwar
Pulwar.name: [color=#af8f50]Glaghar[/color]
Pulwar.rumor: 一把微光直剑，由星界黑暗中的游方行刑者携带

Thunderblade.title: Thunderblade
Thunderblade.name: [color=#0060ff]Thunderblade[/color]
Thunderblade.rumor: 一柄闪烁蓝光的无刃剑柄。曾是 Achra 风暴神殿建立时所依托的圣遗物

AxeDivine.title: AxeDivine
AxeDivine.name: [color=#e0a050]Bull Axe[/color]
AxeDivine.rumor: 一把重量惊人的斧头。在牛巨人被无名冠军击败后从他手中夺得

RagnaAxe.title: RagnaAxe
RagnaAxe.name: [color=#5080ff]Ragna Axe[/color]
RagnaAxe.rumor: 一把曾由某位胆敢入侵炼狱位面的 Surtmir 将军挥舞的斧头

LapisGlaive.title: LapisGlaive

FireShield.title: FireShield
FireShield.name: [color=#ff7000]Fire Shield[/color]
FireShield.rumor: 一面闪耀红光的盾牌。曾由火鸟骑手在对抗“噬星者”的战争中挥舞

DoomBlade.title: DoomBlade
DoomBlade.name: [color=#a0a000]Doom Blade[/color]
DoomBlade.rumor: 一把枯萎之刃，被一位死亡之王在完成神圣解放仪式后遗弃

DragonSword.title: DragonSword
DragonSword.name: [color=#ff7000]Dragon Sword[/color]
DragonSword.rumor: 一把燃烧巨剑，灌注着龙的怒息。燃烧之地早已失落的遗物
